name: $GALINU
causeOfDeath: Promised 10,000x on a Twitter Space. SEC was listening.
epitaph: Aimed for the galaxy. Landed in a federal courthouse.

name: $SOLDOGE
causeOfDeath: Dev's cat walked on keyboard and accidentally drained the LP. Allegedly.
epitaph: Such rug. Much empty. Very gone. Wow.

name: $ELON420
causeOfDeath: Elon sneezed near a microphone and it dumped 99%
epitaph: Flew too close to the sun. The sun sent a cease and desist.

name: $HNYBEAR
causeOfDeath: Buy button worked great. Sell button was decorative.
epitaph: The sweetest trap ever set on-chain. You could check in, but you could never leave.

name: $GRUMPY
causeOfDeath: Civil war broke out over whether the frog should wear a hat or a beret
epitaph: Died as it lived — angry, misunderstood, and holding a bag.

name: $SLAMBO
causeOfDeath: 98% tax hidden in the contract. Dev called it 'a feature.'
epitaph: Promised lambos. Delivered bus tickets.

name: $CHAD
causeOfDeath: Lead dev got grounded by his mom. She also unplugged the server.
epitaph: The chaddest of coins. Even the FBI was impressed.

name: $HAMSTR
causeOfDeath: Hamster literally chewed through the smart contract
epitaph: Ran on its wheel so fast it broke through the floor.

name: $PEPEGLD
causeOfDeath: Matt Furie's lawyers showed up. Pepe has never run so fast.
epitaph: Rare? Yes. Legal? Not even close.

name: $GHOST
causeOfDeath: 47-milestone roadmap. Milestone 1: make a Telegram bot. They almost finished it.
epitaph: Roadmap had 47 milestones. 0 were completed.

name: $RUGCAT
causeOfDeath: Dev said 'brb' in Discord 4 months ago. Still brb.
epitaph: Had nine lives. Used them all in two months.

name: $DUMP
causeOfDeath: Influencer tweeted 'diamond hands forever' then sold 30 seconds later. New speedrun record.
epitaph: He said he'd never sell. The blockchain said otherwise.

name: $CATOSHI
causeOfDeath: The 'revolutionary AI trading engine' was a cron job and a prayer
epitaph: The AI was artificial. The intelligence was absent.

name: $REKTAPE
causeOfDeath: Dev said he was 'migrating funds.' Migrated them straight to his personal wallet.
epitaph: Not all apes go to heaven. Most go to zero.

name: $SHEEP
causeOfDeath: Dev went to 'find himself in Bali.' Found a beach bar instead.
epitaph: Followed the herd. Right off the cliff.

name: $BWHALE
causeOfDeath: Top 3 wallets dumped at the same time. Plot twist: same guy.
epitaph: Called themselves whales. Turned out to be the same whale.

name: $COPIUM
causeOfDeath: Holders formed a support group. Chart kept going down. Support group kept growing.
epitaph: It never came back. But the copium was real.

name: $BURGER
causeOfDeath: Ronald McDonald personally called the dev. It was not a happy meal.
epitaph: I'm lovin' it. McDonald's lawyers were not.

name: $YOLO
causeOfDeath: Entire team was one guy and his goldfish. Goldfish quit on day 11.
epitaph: You only launch once. Apparently you only develop once too.

name: $WPEPE
causeOfDeath: Dev clicked 'free NFT mint' link in his own Discord. Yes, really.
epitaph: Cast a spell of prosperity. Got phished instead.
